create_iterative_thought_agent: create an IterativeThoughtAgent that solves problems through iterative LLM prompting with a single next step per iteration
create_iterative_thought_proposer_agent: create an IterativeThoughtProposerAgent that prompts the LLM to propose multiple candidate next steps at once
build_iterative_thought_prompt: build a Jinja2 prompt template for IterativeThoughtAgent that generates a single next thought step
build_iterative_thought_proposer_prompt: build a Jinja2 prompt template for IterativeThoughtProposerAgent that generates multiple candidate next steps
run_iterative_thought_state: run IterativeThoughtState to track a sequence of LLM-generated thought steps with input and update list state
